description.p: Nothing Linux is an unofficial, local desktop controller for Nothing Ear audio devices.
It displays battery and wear status and provides confirmed controls for noise cancellation, equalization, gestures, and device tools. It has no accounts, telemetry, or cloud dependency.
Ensure the AppImage root icon itself is PNG for reliable Gear Lever and sidebar integration.
Use a PNG root icon in the AppImage so desktop launchers and Gear Lever integrations display it reliably.
Fix the AppImage startup crash and remove an unused incompatible media module from the portable bundle.
Improved Hyprland window behavior, Bluetooth discovery and reconnection, status visibility, equalizer preset graphs, and AppImage integration and updates.
Initial source release focused on Nothing Ear 2024 (B171).
